svg.aria-label: Voyance: Hotel inventory planning. Decides which hotel-weeks to pre-buy on a budget. It recovers demand hidden by sell-outs and weighs profit against the risk of unsold rooms. Built for: TBO VoyageHack 4.0. Key result: +14–24% (sim.). Built with: Python, SciPy, FastAPI.
